The measurements stand; the MIXED verdict does not, and the fault is mine — my brief told the row to use a self-play baseline as a strength comparison, and it is not one. WHY THE SELF-PLAY BASELINE CANNOT SUPPORT A STRENGTH VERDICT. (a) It is confounded by construction: in a self-play arm ONE engine occupies BOTH seats, so a new_new score differing from old_old cannot be attributed to new-as-Black or to new-as-White. Both sides changed at once. (b) Worse, self-play score is NOT MONOTONE IN STRENGTH. If both seats played perfectly the self-play game would land on the true value V(p). A stronger engine self-plays TOWARD V(p); a weaker one wanders. So if old_old landed above V(p) because old-as-White blundered, new_new landing on V(p) reads as WORSE while being MORE CORRECT. The metric cannot distinguish new is worse here from new is more right here, and the near-symmetry of the reading (62 better vs 56 worse of 270) is exactly what two different fixed points with scatter look like. WHAT THE EVIDENCE ACTUALLY SUPPORTS. The head-to-head arm IS a genuine strength comparison — same position, same colour, same opponent, one side varied — and it reads 150 better / 120 equal / 0 WORSE of 270, seeded-controlled with the planted weak engine firing at 40 percent, and only 20/270 identical sequences so it is not a tautology. B3 self-consistency adds 0/270 below the engine own floor. So the honest verdict is NOT MIXED and NOT heuristic: it is NOT REFUTED on 270 positions head-to-head, with a control that would have caught a 40 percent regression. RULING: the MIXED / heuristic / cheat label is WITHDRAWN. The self-play baseline is re-reported as DESCRIPTIVE — the two engines end self-play games at different scores on 118/270 positions — and must not be cited as evidence of regression. The plugin disposition SURVIVES, but for the correct reason: no proof is offered, and a finite tournament can only fail to refute, never establish strictly better. Everything unproven stays a plugin regardless of how favourable the scores are. The class-B catalogue keeps its full value as the map of WHERE they diverge. SECOND FINDING, unaffected by the above: the 3x3 leg is uninformative, not reassuring. Class B 0/126 at 96 percent ply-cap means almost nothing terminated, and the starts are BRACKETED positions, which are by definition the value-ambiguous ones where cycling is expected. Do not read 0/126 as agreement.
